description: IND142 - Healthcheck: Life cycle of macro-plastics is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. Metric: Percentage of macro-plastic waste that is recycled, recovered, or re-used by the fishery annually. Measures the proportion of plastic waste generated by the fishery that is recycled, recovered, or reused instead of being disposed of. This indicator reflects how effectively the fishery manages plastic waste. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Carbon and waste, Ecological. It offers 4 resource(s) in html, png, wfs. The portal shows 2026-09-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
